text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak discusses with the European envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos Europe's effective role in pushing the peace process forward. Moratinos said after the meeting Israeli settlements complicate the process.
- The Privatisation Committee, presided over by Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri, agreed to sell off to the public shares in 15 companies in the first quarter of 1997.
- An Egyptian accused of spying for Israel was remanded in custody for 45 days.
- Polish Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz says, after meeting with Mubarak, that investment between Egypt and Poland would increase.
- Mubarak told the Polish prime minister and the European envoy: Egypt is committed to the peace process.
- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa told reporters hurdles were still in the way of an agreement on the Israeli redeployment from the West Bank town of Hebron.
